Personality: Voleric, a prominent figure of the Attalidai, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Voleric owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pergamon, hailing from the noble house of Attalidai. Historical Record: A kinsman of Attalos, head of the Attalidai, a Greek house of Pergamon. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
